description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontHot TubGulf Front Renovated Ground Floor Condo with Amazing Views - Blue Tide 7AThe Space Blue Tide 7A – Gulf-Front Retreat in Seacrest Beach! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Direct Gulf-Front Condo – Wake up to stunning Emerald Coast views Private Beach Access – Just steps from your door to the sugar-white sand Community Pool – Cool off and relax in the complex’s private pool Recently Renovated – All-new tile flooring, kitchen cabinets, granite countertops & stainless steel appliances Spacious 1-Bedroom, 1-Bathroom Layout – Perfect for couples or small families, sleeps up to 4 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s charming beach towns with ease Prime Location – Nestled between Rosemary Beach & Seagrove for quick access to shopping & dining Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected while enjoying your beach escape 1 Assigned Parking Spot + Limited Overflow – Hassle-free parking One Set of Beach Chairs Included (March - October) – Ultimate relaxation by the Gulf Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest Service for a seamless stayWelcome to Blue Tide 7ARENOVATED WITH ALL NEW TILE FLOORING THROUGHOUT. NEW KITCHEN CABINETS, GRANITE COUNTERTOPS, STAINLESS STEEL DISHWASHER AND OVEN. BEAUTIFUL RENOVATION THAT SETS 7A APART FROM THE REST!Enjoy all the Emerald Coast has to offer when you stay at Blue Tide 7A, a one-bedroom ground floor condo tucked away in the beautiful area of Seacrest Beach. This impeccably kept condo is the perfect getaway destination for a couple or small family as it offers accommodations for up to four guests. Blue Tide’s private beach access is just steps from your door and when you need to cool off from the beach be sure to check out the complex’s private pool. Blue Tide is located between Rosemary Beach and Seagrove allowing for swift access to a variety of shopping and dining venues spread out along the coast.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6):Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private BathroomBuilt in twin bunks in HallwayLiving Room: Queen Sleeper SofaAREA ATTRACTONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
